description: After appeasing Tinny’s boozy needs, the Witch is ready to teach you the basics of Runespeak. However, you are missing a wand. You must find a suitable Black Yuckaw branch for Tinny to enchant. Search the near the water of Kingsport Lake near Lakewood Inn to find a suitable tree.
name: Witch’s Apprentice
completed: You've gathered a branch, return to Tinny and unlock the hidden power of the branch.
